verdict.rationale: Salesforce documents an official MCP server, platform APIs and a CLI with data commands. It also lists lead management and built-in lead routing for owner assignment, and Agentforce agents that qualify inbound leads and can call Flows and Apex. Together these give an agent the core pieces to create a lead and route it to an owner. However, nothing in the evidence shows filling in company or firmographic data, and no source documents this lead workflow end to end via API or MCP. Missing for 10: documented company-data enrichment capability, explicit API/MCP lead create-and-assign workflow docs, hands-on or independent corroboration of the end-to-end agent flow.
